description: Create an export of the records (default), another dataset, or `all` (the year-end package) for a period, or for the entire history when period is null or omitted. Returns the export object: small exports are already `ready` with `file` (name, content_type, bytes, sha256) and a signed `download_url` valid until `download_expires_at` (files are kept 7 days); while `queued` or `processing` call get_export. Vendor presets (quickbooks, xero, koinly, cointracker, coinledger) and journal need dataset=records and format=csv (otherwise 422). Verify the downloaded file against file.sha256. With a test key pass include_simulated=true to include simulated payments.

currency.description: Reporting currency of the value columns.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key so a retry does not start a second export, e.g. records-2026-q3.

include_simulated.description: Test mode only: include rows created by simulate_test_payment, which the sandbox hides by default. Ignored with a live key.

metadata.description: Up to 50 string key/value pairs returned on the object and in webhooks.

period.description: Read in `timezone`. Null or omitted exports the entire history.

preset.description: Column layout for the records dataset (default generic).

timezone.description: IANA zone, e.g. America/New_York. Default: the account's records timezone.

name: create_export
title: Export records as CSV, Excel or JSON
